notes.title: Bugfixes & Steam Trading Cards
notes.notes:
Marco & The Galaxy Dragon now supports Steam trading cards! Collect new community items including cards, badges, emoticons, and profile backgrounds from all over the galaxy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36458200/4437c3682bc7ef10325b93d0c18729b1a1e7737b.jpg

The game has also received a couple of updates over the past month. We'll be summarizing the changes below!

Version 1.03
Fixed a bug which caused incorrect images and videos for the current Main Language to appear in some scenes.
Corrected some text errors (typos).
Adjusted some CGs to use the correct final art.
Adjusted song names in Sound Mode.

Version 1.02
Hotfix for a launch bug in which some Achievements could not be correctly unlocked.
